labels: At the entrance mat, the student holds a closed umbrella by its handle with the tip angled toward the mat and droplets visible at the folded canopy's edge.; 현관 매트에서 학생이 닫힌 우산 손잡이를 쥐고 끝을 매트 쪽으로 기울이며 접힌 우산 가장자리에 물방울이 보인다.
definition: Complete optional school-life visual realization: At the entrance mat, the student holds a closed umbrella by its handle with the tip angled toward the mat and droplets visible at the folded canopy's edge.
aliases: 우산 물기와 손의 상태
